data.name: Timaeus
data.gender_notes: Timaeus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'timē,' meaning 'honor, esteem,' and 'theos,' meaning 'God.' The name Timaeus signifies 'friend of God' in Greek. The name Timaeus carries the meaning “Friend of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Timaeus usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes a strong connection to the divine, representing a deep faith and devotion to God.
data.etymology: Timaeus belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Timaeus total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: טִימַאוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם טִימַאוס נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'טִימֵא', שפירושה כבוד, הערכה או יקיר. הוא משמש לעיתים קרובות בהקשר של כבוד או יקיר לאלוהים, ומשקף מאפיינים של כבוד, יושר ומסירות.

in_greek.name: Τίμαιος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όνομα Τίμαιος προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'τίμη', που σημαίνει τιμή, σεβασμός ή εκτίμηση. Στο πλαίσιο της Καινής Διαθήκης και της πρώιμης Εκκλησίας, το όνομα αυτό πιθανότατα συμβόλιζε την τιμή ή την ευλάβεια προς τον Θεό, αντανακλώντας χαρακτηριστικά όπως η σεβαστότητα, η ειλικρίνεια και η αφοσίωση.

in_latin.name: Timaeus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Timaeus is derived from the Greek word 'timē', meaning honor, esteem, or value. In the context of early Christian tradition, it likely signified honor or reverence towards God, reflecting qualities of dignity, integrity, and devotion.

in_english.name: Timaeus
in_english.long_meaning: The name Timaeus originates from the Greek word 'timē', meaning honor or esteem. It appears in the New Testament (Mark 10:35, Matthew 20:20) as the name of the father of Bartimaeus, a blind beggar healed by Jesus. The name symbolizes qualities of respectability, sincerity, and dedication, and is associated with spiritual significance in Christian tradition, reflecting values of humility and faith.

data.cultural_impact: In ancient Greek philosophical literature, Timaeus is the name of the protagonist in Plato's philosophical text "Timaeus," where he expounds on the creation of the universe. This philosophical text has had a significant impact on Western thought, particularly in areas of cosmology, epistemology, and metaphysics.
data.spiritual_significance: Although Timaeus means 'friend of God' in Greek, as a Christian name, it can be understood as a reminder of our ultimate goal to be not just friends of God, but servants and followers of His will. It calls us to strive for a deep, personal relationship with Him, and to live a life that honors and reflects His divine nature.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Timaeus is a name of Greek origin, deriving from the word 'timao', meaning 'honor'. In Christian tradition, Timaeus symbolizes the seeking of divine honor and wisdom, reflecting the biblical figure who, in the wisdom literature of Proverbs, is praised for his godly fear and prudence.

biblical_reference.note: Father of Bartimaeus, a blind beggar healed by Jesus

historical_references.reference: Plato's dialogue 'Timaeus', written around 360 BC, describes a creation myth in which the god Timaeus creates the universe.

trends: As a given name for boys
modern_usage.modern_context: Timaeus is a name of Greek origin that has been in use since ancient times. It is derived from the Greek word 'timē' meaning 'honor' or 'esteem'. In modern times, the name Timaeus has been used as a given name for boys and as a surname. It is also used in various social media platforms and email addresses.

name_in_real_life.story: John Timaeus from Athens, Greece embodies the meaning of Timaeus - "Friend of God". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
